props.text: FOMC Playbook 101 — Post-Fed decision QQQ structure: initial capitulation (to ~665 on 5m), fakeout bounce attempt, then structural recovery. Charts show multi-timeframe pattern across 1m/5m/15m/30m with major volume spike at announcement, now recovering toward 678+ (reversing from 666 lows).
